title: PAGE WALLET STAYS HIDDEN IN THE NEW HUD FRAME
why: His wallet collision was fixed in v35.01. Verification found one remaining timing gap: after a slow frame the loop could unclip the page wallet before the HUD refreshed its stamp. The corner draw now clips the page wallet immediately, including when the quiet HUD has no wallet rows.
now: The old corner money text stays hidden as soon as the raid HUD draws.
